inputs.text:
Working-class solidarity was on full display in Abuja on Thursday as healthcare workers, organized under the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations, took to the streets at the Unity Fountain in Maitama to challenge the ruling establishment and demand an end to top-down, exclusionary governance. 

These frontline workers are rising up against the elite-driven agenda embedded in the controversial reform bills currently being pushed through the National Assembly. This is a clear manifestation of systemic exploitation within our institutions, where marginalized labor forces are forced to fight for their fundamental rights and dignity against a legislative system that consistently protects entrenched power rather than the workers who sustain society. We must stand with these healthcare professionals as they demand structural reform and accountability from those in power.
